deck_title: Piegl-Tiller rational NURBS conic arc vs naive polynomial Bezier bulge rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Piegl & Tiller (The NURBS Book) & Forrest (1968) rational quadratic Bezier conic arc (apex homogeneous weight w1 = cos(120 deg / 2) = 0.5000, projective denominator W(u) = 1 - u + u^2, locking exact circle radius R(u) = 1.0000x with zero trig/sqrt) versus naive non-rational polynomial quadratic Bezier (w1 = 1.0, which bulges outward to 1.2500x at u = 0.50 across all 15/17 interior stations) and 64-step trigonometric Frenet integration across 17 arc stations.

Unified trig-free representation of ellipses (0 < w1 < 1), parabolas (w1 = 1), and hyperbolas (w1 > 1)

not_for: Constant-angular-velocity motion without arc-length reparameterization (use Slerp when constant angular speed dTheta/du is mandatory)
